audit.exposure_note: Logical reader-1 successor began 2026-10-24T19:56Z; predecessor declarations and evidence preserved in hashed predecessor-record copies. Successor previously read HANDOFF and authorized editorial/narrative documents: aggregate HG002 6/7/8, HG001 7/8/8, phenotype-only 4/8/8 of nine; compact 556/653/665 versus 430/649/665 of 681; historical FGFR2 rank 1 at 0.9654. Editorial exposure after 18:54:47Z included CTCF phenotype rank 132 versus genomic 1/1; DOCK8 2 versus 22/15; all three modes 8/9 top10; COG8/SLC35C1 one-allele exceptions; constructed pairs 58/64 versus 42/64 and no-HPO 59/64 versus 2/64. Later narrative review repeated aggregate summaries and source-audit coverage, and actual synthetic rescue-rule outputs were seen. No benchmark/inference outcome files or case outcomes were opened or consulted for this successor source review. Conservatively per_case, post-inference and not blinded; this does not retroactively make predecessor review blinded.
